title: BallWatch
summary: Multi-persona basketball analytics platform with role-specific insights for coaches, GMs, and analysts.

blocks.content:
## Overview

BallWatch is a multi-persona basketball analytics platform that surfaces role-specific insights for coaches, general managers, and analysts — built on a normalized MySQL database of real NBA season data.

## What I Built

Designed a schema to store player stats, team performance, and game logs, then built a Flask API layer with persona-aware query routing. A Streamlit front end lets each user type — coach, GM, scout — see exactly the data relevant to their decisions without wading through noise.

## Stack

Flask · MySQL · SQLAlchemy · Streamlit · Python
